testCase.name: [本地] S23 Wrong browser clock (48 h behind, or +13 h in another time zone): points neither vanish nor take the device's time

descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B18 · P1 · 已知

很多时间和日期按设备时钟算，没有用服务器时间（违反 UAT 3.8）：「NEW TODAY」、入院日期、体征日期、任务完成时间、转录日期都跟着手机走；手机慢两天时停药被打成两天前，下次清理就把这个药删了

票：TFA-92584 ready for qa（UAT 3.8） · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：本地

注：根因已知（Daniela 10-03 提过要用服务器时间）；删药、掉标签、草稿恢复错这几个症状是新的

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：TC-01/S08, TC-10/S22, TC-19/S19, TC-22/S23, TC-25/S24a, TC-02/S13b, EFS/S28, TC-16/S25

思路 / Approach · TC-12 Important Points · S23 「浏览器时钟错（慢 48 h，或在别的时区快 13 h）：要点不会消失，也不会用设备的时间」 Wrong browser clock (48 h behind, or +13 h in another time zone): points neither vanish nor take the device's time

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U8 The expiry clock uses server time, not device time: a phone with a wrong date, no clock set, or another time zone shows the same points as any other device.（UAT 3.8；TFA-94699 AC 7） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U5 Points expire 12 h after they were written; a point checked 13 h after it was written is gone (Hospital 3.6: Important Points 12 h; TC-12 step 6 repeats it in Nursing Home). …（UAT TC-12；UAT 3.6；TFA-92590 AC 6；TFA-94699 AC 2） — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • U3 Re-saving the pre-round note with different content leaves every point untouched: Save Note never adds, edits, or removes a point.（UAT TC-12；TFA-92590 AC 2；TFA-92590 description） — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • U7 Every step is repeated in Nursing Home and must pass in both modes.（UAT TC-12；UAT 3.3；TFA-92590 AC 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress

测试设计方法：设备（device） — 在手机尺寸或真机（iPhone / Pixel）上看布局和手势。

Given Local stack; Playwright contexts with the same account: one with clock.setSystemTime(now - 48 h), a variant with timezoneId 'Pacific/Kiritimati' and the clock +13 h, and one with the normal clock

When In each mode, in the wrong-clock context: add a point, Save Note, open and close the editor, reload. Then open the same chart in the normal-clock context

Then The point is present in both contexts after every step; the stored points clock is server time

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT 3.8, TFA-94699 AC 7 (clocks use server time). Judged: the point is listed in both contexts after add, Save Note, open/close and reload; an admin read shows ptsEditedAt within +-2 min of the server's time:now. Main writes ptsEditedAt from the browser (buildReviewedNotePatch, usePreRoundProcess, PreRoundNotesCard, Nursing Home closeEditor and handleProcess all use Date.now() …

在哪跑：本地 newspec-b（新写的 Playwright）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（blocked）

S23 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-12.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：已知产品问题 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92590 in progress；TFA-94699 in progress

手机时钟慢 48 小时时，新加的 Important Point 被记成 48 小时前写的，下一次清理就在所有设备上消失；养老院用这个时钟保存的预查房文字刷新后也没了。

On a phone whose clock is 48 h behind, a newly added Important Point is stamped as 48 h old and is deleted from the chart on every device at the next lifecycle pass. In Nursing Home, the pre-round text saved with that clock is also gone after a reload.

依据：allure e88a7b99: ptsEditedAt is stored on the device clock (-2880 / +780 min vs the server). OAT-04 knownGaps K10 already records that retention clocks are stamped with the browser clock (TFA-94699 AC 7, in progress). The S23 oracle expected this fail, and TC-12 risks list it. With the Kiritimati +13 h clock the points survive.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane newspec-b。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：newspec-b。

UAT item: TC-12 Important Points · Section: A2 · Pre-Round · Scenario: TC-12/S23

Wrong browser clock (48 h behind, or +13 h in another time zone): points neither vanish nor take the device's time

Tickets: TFA-92590 Important Points (in progress); TFA-94699 Data Retention & Purge (in progress)

本地新 lane newspec-b：newspec-b/results.json 里 status failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 标了产品问题））。

怎么测（newspec-b/plan.json，automatable: yes）：Chromium spec, fresh account, contexts: clock now−48 h; timezoneId Pacific/Kiritimati with clock +13 h; normal. In each mode add a point, Save Note (parse answered at the socket), open/close editor, reload; then open the chart in the normal context; read ptsEditedAt via the chart query and compare with server time (time:now if callable). — Device clock via Playwright; parse mocked so the run is about the clock, not the model.

Detail:

Re-run 17:10. Hospital −48 h: the point is stored on add, Save Note and open/close with ptsEditedAt −2880 min vs server; it is deleted by the next lifecycle pass (in this run the wrong-clock page's own reload ran it) and the normal-clock context shows nothing. Nursing Home −48 h: the point is kept and shown in both contexts, but stamped 48 h old (−2880 min), and the NH pre-round text saved under that clock was '' after the reload. Kiritimati +13 h (saved session refused, signed in again; see _observations): points survive in both modes and both contexts, but ptsEditedAt is +780 min vs server. Every run stores ptsEditedAt on the device clock (oracle: within ±2 min of server time).

产品问题：Hospital: a physician whose phone clock is two days behind adds 'QA-CLOCK check telemetry'; it is stamped 48 h old and deleted at the next lifecycle pass, so it disappears from the chart for everyone. Nursing Home: the point is kept but stamped 48 h old, and the NH pre-round text saved under that clock was gone after reload. A clock 13 h ahead stamps points 13 h in the future (they outlive their expiry). Breaks TC-12 U8 (UAT 3.8, TFA-94699 AC 7: clocks use server time). Cause: ptsEditedAt is written from the browser's Date.now().

证据：附了 4 个。

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (our scripted spec, not written yet): page.clock / timezoneId browser contexts on a fresh local account, plus an admin read of ptsEditedAt and time:now; dev has no admin key, so it runs on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
